# Version archive

Tablet candidates 0.2.70 and 0.2.71 are incomplete WIP snapshots. Tablet debugging was stopped by the user; history-toolbar touch heights and low-height header overlays remain unresolved. See [tablet status](../docs/tablet-layout.md).

This index covers the retained public build artifacts in this repository. Archiving a signed UI snapshot does not mean it was activated on the live update channel.

- Last device-accepted Android APK: **0.2.69**.
- Latest Android tablet candidate: **0.2.71** (build 73); installation and physical-device acceptance are pending. Android 0.2.70 is the earlier tablet candidate.
- Latest Windows application: **0.2.67**.
- Latest signed UI candidate: **0.2.71**; Cursor UI 0.2.70 is retained as an earlier candidate. Neither is published to the live channel. Last observed live UI: **0.2.67**.
- Android 0.2.67 and 0.2.68 are retained for history; 0.2.69 contains both the native resource and update-feed fixes.
- Older signed manifests retain their original bytes and expiration dates; an archived manifest may no longer be eligible for installation.
- Private connection defaults, signing keys, local runtime data, screenshots and terminal content are excluded.

Machine-readable paths and SHA-256 hashes: [versions.json](versions.json).
